name: AMDGPU Native Wayland Compositor in RISC-V Assembly

mentions.name: AMDGPU Native Wayland Compositor in RISC-V Assembly
mentions.description: A native Wayland compositor for Linux targeting AMDGPU, written in RISC-V assembly and run on x86_64 via a small interpreter that is itself written in x86_64 assembly. Ongoing work includes an XDG-compliant config file loader for xkb configuration of Linux input event devices, which will mmap only the first 4KiB page.
